notes.notes:

notes.title: [Global] PATCH NOTES - JULY UPDATE 2025
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Dear Players,[/b][/h3][p]We're scheduling a maintenance shutdown from 6:00 AM to 12:00 AM(UTC+8) on July 17, 2025. After the maintenance is complete, each player will receive 600 Gold, 600 Stardust Crystals, 6000 Silver, and 6000 Disorder Crystals (please claim within 7 days from receiving the mail).  [/p][p][/p][h2]  Game Mode [/h2][p]
[b]= New mode: Blade Runner =[/b]

    ●Players are divided into two camps to fight against each other. The winner is the one who eliminates all enemies within the specified time.[/p][p]    ●A minimum of 2 players and a maximum of 16 players, 8v8[/p][p]    ●Each game has 5 rounds, and you can customize the rounds to 5/7/9. The default match is 5 rounds.[/p][p]    ●Introduction to special mechanisms:

[b]     [/b] ◆Skills will be randomly refreshed in the scene, and skills can be picked up to assist in attack
[b]     [/b] ◆The picked up skills can only be used once and disappear after use
[b]     [/b] ◆Each player will have a fixed body movement skill--->Retreat jump, no limit on the number of times, but with a cooldown time limit

notes.title: [Global] PATCH NOTES - JUNE UPDATE 2025
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Dear Players,[/b][/h3]
We're scheduling a maintenance shutdown from 6:00 AM to 12:00 AM(UTC+8) on June 5, 2025. After the maintenance is complete, each player will receive 600 Gold, 600 Stardust Crystals, 6000 Silver, and 6000 Disorder Crystals (please claim within 7 days from receiving the mail).

[h2] Season update [/h2]

[b]=  SS3 New Season Launch =[/b]
[list]
[*] After the service suspension update on June 5, the game will switch to the SS3 season, which will be from 2025-06-05 to 2025-09-03.
[*] During the SS3 season, players can unlock the Scar Star after fighting 5 games after reaching Gold in the Ladder, and can unlock the M4A1 Frostfang + Super Season Medal 1 after play 5 games after reaching Black Gold in the Ladder.
[*] During the SS3 season, players can unlock the Jetpack Relived Years after fighting 3 games after reaching Gold in the Battle Royale, and can unlock the Sedan Rachel after play 3 games after reaching Black Gold in the Ladder.
[/list]

[h2] Game Mode [/h2]

[b]=  New Mode: Hide and seek =[/b]
[list]
[*] 10 players are divided into two camps to compete. The camp whose team members first get 24 points wins. When respawning, you will be randomly selected on the map.
[*] Players are divided into two camps to compete. The catcher needs to catch all the hiders to win the game, while the hiders need to survive to the end to win.
[*] A minimum of 2 players and a maximum of 18 players are required to form a game. (6) catchers vs. (12) hiders.
[*] Each game has three rounds. Custom support is available for modifying rounds 3/5/7. The default is three rounds.
[*] Introduction to roles and skills
      ◆The catcher uses a big-headed hero to play the game; the hider uses a small animal to play the game.
      ◆The same type of big-headed hero/small animal has the same skill; both the catcher and the hider can use skills to fight.
      ◆Press F9 to view skill descriptions in the game. ◆ The skill demonstration video can be viewed in [Lobby Page] - [Role] - [Big-Headed Hero].
[*] Introduction to role features
      ◆Hider:
      ◆Can possess objects in the scene, with a cooldown and no limit on the number of times; can also use skills to avoid being hunted down;
      ◆After possessing an object, F10 on the right side of the game will play corresponding prompts according to different states;
      ◆The catcher:
      ◆Use the weapon that comes with the big-headed hero as the main means of attack. When there is no person hidden in the object being attacked, it will be slowed down; but when using a throwing knife to attack an object that does not hide a person, it will not be slowed down;
      ◆The throwing knife attack has a cooling limit, but no limit on the number of times;
[*] Special mechanism in the game
      ◆The final moment will be opened at the end of the countdown of each round. At this time, the catcher will no longer be slowed down when attacking an object that does not hide a person, and will also get a grenade, which has no number of uses and no CD
      ◆Grenade, shovel and throwing knife can be switched at any time; at this time, the hider's movement speed will become faster

notes.title: [Global] PATCH NOTES - December UPDATE 2024
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Dear Players,[/b][/h3]
We're scheduling a maintenance shutdown from 6:00 AM to 14:00 AM(UTC+8) on December 19, 2024. After the maintenance is complete, each player will receive 500 Gold, 500 Stardust Crystals, 3000 Silver, and 3000 Disorder Crystals (please claim within 7 days from receiving the mail).

[h2] Season [/h2]

[b]=  SS1 Season Supply Pack Online =[/b]
[list]
[*] Seasonal supply packs have been revised, with a large number of new rewards. From this version, we will activate the direct purchase method for Supply Packs.
[*] Season Supply Exclusive Weapons (Unlock Time: After the Service Update on December 19, 2024 - March 12, 2025)
[*] New legendary weapon:Kar98K Buildblock
[*] New legendary weapon:Vector Amethyst Glow
[*] New legendary weapon:MSR Jade Harp
[*] Season supply exclusive skin (unlock time: after the service stop update on December 19, 2024 - March 12, 2025 )
[*] Miss B-Moonlight Lute
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42378447/2dddd97beeff4f25d780a49e60fcb0974ab0a3cc.png[/img]
[b]= Adjustments to season tasks and season experience =[/b]
[list]
[*] Daily mission gold coin rewards increased
[*] Add new limited-time tasks, complete them to get a large amount of gold coins, stardust crystals and other rewards
[*] Experience burden reduction: The season level experience obtained from daily tasks and weekly tasks has been greatly increased, and the efficiency of generating experience through combat has been slightly reduced. Now players can more easily upgrade their season level.
[/list]

[b]=  SS1 New Season Starts =[/b]
[list]
[*] After the server was stopped and updated on December 19, it was switched to the SS1 season. Now the rank rewards and season rewards are integrated into the ladder introduction page.
[*] During the SS1 season, players can unlock QBZ192 Dynasty Charm by fighting 5 games after reaching the gold rank. After reaching black gold, they can unlock Kar98K Dynasty Charm + Super Season Medal 1 by fighting 5 games.
[*] During the SS1 season, players can unlock the Jetpack 2nd Anniversary by fighting 3 games after reaching Gold in the Black Gold Exercise Rank. Players can unlock the Off-road vehicle Two-Year Anniversary by fighting 3 games after reaching Black Gold.
[*] Newly added competition year medal re-signing function, players can obtain past competition year medals by achieving rank requirements
[/list]

[b]= New Season Activity System =[/b]
[list]
[*] Players can accumulate active points by participating in the team ladder, blasting ladder, and ink gold mode to obtain rewards. For detailed rules and active rewards, please check in the game.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42378447/7920f210b33e5b539d622a11b8c699e501b21ad5.png[/img]
[b]= Ladder Adjustment =[/b]
[list]
[*] New reward types added to the ladder: Team Star, Elite Commendation.
[*] Team Star: When a player performs well in the current ladder match and makes a great contribution to the team, he or she can get an extra star at the end of the game.
[*] Elite Recognition: If a player triggers the Team Star multiple times in recent ladder matches, a cross-level promotion will be triggered, and the player will be promoted to a lower level. The recent performance of the cross-level promotion will be calculated independently of the blasting ladder and the team ladder.
[*] In ladder matching, the option to match only single players has been optimized and corrected to prioritize single players. When the matching time reaches a certain extent and still no game is formed, the player will enter the random pool and match with random players.
[/list]

[h2] INFESTATION [/h2]

[b]=  Battle of Spore Queen - Part I Nightmare =[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated the in-game store, adding new burning cards: Critical Focus, Flame Burst, Flame Expertise, Charged Charge, Electro-Shock Apprentice, Electro-Shock Clip. There is also a small chance that a red burning card crystal core mutation will be refreshed.
[*] 5 burning card slots are available in the nightmare difficulty of the first part of the Battle of the Mother Fungus.
[*] For enemies with [Electricity] and [Fire] elemental shields or elemental health bars, it is recommended to use [Electricity] and [Fire] attribute attacks respectively to effectively weaken their shields or health.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42378447/138194e0ebf0e58f929081061f1d779b405f4574.png[/img]
[b]=  New Monsters =[/b]
[list]
[*] Wraith Dragon Remains

[*] Puppetbear King
[/list]

[b]=  New rewards for Battle of Spore Queen - Part I Nightmare =[/b]
[list]
[*] Incendiary Dragonbone
[*] Dual Clawblade Coreforce
[/list]

[b]=  Starfall Expedition Season Update =[/b]
[list]
[*] Starfall Expedition opens a new season and new rewards
       ◆Starfall Hourglass (Epic)
       ◆Crystal Core Light and Shadow Phantom Collapse Force Field Light Abyss (Legendary)
       ◆Crystal Core Light and Shadow Phantom Cluster Rocket Purple Flame (Epic)
       ◆Crystal Core Light and Shadow Phantom Collapse Field Star Abyss (Legendary)
[*] New expedition challenge task system, players can choose the corresponding challenge task before starting the game to increase expedition points.
[/list]

[b]=  New Crystal Core =[/b]
[list]
[*] M590A1 Doomsday Explosion
       ◆How to obtain: obtain through exciting activities
       ◆After releasing the skill, the ammunition is upgraded to a fireball, causing area damage. The energy is consumed over time during the skill. When damage is caused to the target, the energy is restored proportionally. The skill ends when the energy is exhausted or the skill duration expires.

They will explode after a period of time, leaving a fire field on the ground, causing continuous damage to monsters. After activating the skill, all the flames released by the arrows will be detonated, and monsters in the fire field will be vulnerable to fire attributes.

       ◆Turing Support Release: Turing Support will produce overclocking related props.

[*] This time, the overclocking effects of the 5 crystal cores [Particle Shielding], [Doomblast], [Fire Hell of Exorcism] ,[Electricity Shock]and [Ballistic Lightning] will be launched first, and other crystal cores will be gradually launched in future versions.

[b]=  Turing Support 7 =[/b]

[*] This issue of Turing Support will include more content, with no additional cost

Collecting 10 [Demonfire Purgatory Charger] can upgrade the limited-time crystal core [Compound Crossfire Blaze] to a permanent crystal core.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42378447/f704f944ffab2dbfa35c5c42b1b677b95590ceb7.png[/img]
[b]=  Additional Rewards =[/b]
[list]

[b]=  Display Optimization =[/b]
[list]

The actual drop method remains unchanged, with fragments and a very small chance of dropping a whole weapon.

      ◆Fragmentation Grenade: Unlimited number of fragmentation grenades, double the power!
      ◆Snowball: A single-shot weapon with a slow trajectory and a lot of ballistic drop. It is difficult to hit, so practice requires diligence.
[*] The last weapon (the 24th weapon) in the weapon upgrade sequence is fixed as a melee weapon.
[*] Players can set a preferred skin for each prototype weapon, and use it to obtain the set skin and accessories in the firepower advanced mode (if the player does not configure it, he will get the prototype gun without accessories)
[*] Setting entrance: Lobby interface - [Weapons] - [Illustration] - [Blueprint Details], click the "Collect" button on the gun skins that you already have corresponding to each prototype gun. If you "Collect" multiple weapons at the same time, you will get them randomly in the set weapons.

[h2]Infestation Mode[/h2]

[b]=  Newly added main storyline map: The Battle of Spore Queen, Part 2 =[/b]
[list]
[*] After reaching an alliance with Hannah, the squad delves into the city under her guidance, entering the grand theater to deal with the third biological interference source while searching for Mia. Hannah is frantic as her daughter has been taken by the Spore Queen, and she charges ahead, handling many dangers for the squad. Once they reach the underground parking garage, she pushes team members aside and gets ensnared by the vines. Under the commander’s decisive orders, the squad continues forward, locating the biological interference source while also discovering Hannah, who is being drained of energy by the monsters. After a fierce battle, Hannah is rescued, but just as everyone begins to relax, a mutation occurs.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42378447/4f2634c8b24b45f337c8dd938a5f58b85e38a7b5.jpg[/img]

[b]=  New BOSS =[/b]
[list]
[*] Mother of Bacteria
[*] When the Star Ring shattered, a peculiar connection between stardust caused a synchronous explosion deep beneath the city of Saint Alexus. This explosion created a singularity point that existed for only 0.1 milliseconds, allowing a spore from another world to fall through the point into the depths underground. The Age of the Great Fall began, as the debris obliterated much of Saint Alexus. Several pieces of stardust penetrated the soil, stopping near the foreign spore, which began to grow by harnessing the energy from these stardust fragments.  
On the surface, after the dense fallout, Saint Alexus started to rebuild, managing to almost completely restore the previous damage in just three years. By this time, the spore had grown into a massive entity. Due to Amos's mining of stardust, it was disturbed and devoured an entire exploration team. It then moved upward through the tunnel created by the team, eventually discovering the human city above. In its eyes, humans were the finest food source. Lacking cognitive ability, it launched a surprise attack, with vines bursting out from the underground pipes, plunging Saint Alexus into disaster...
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42378447/c72334143c1f366f76743cdf2571591241ee11ee.png[/img]

[b]=  New Monsters =[/b]
[list]
[*] Puppet clown\Puppet bear
[*] The Spore Queen has been attempting to create the perfect life form, and the Nightmare Clown is one of its abandoned failures. No one knows which organisms the Spore Queen used to transform the Clown. Based on scattered whispers found in various corners of the grand theater, it’s speculated that the Clown might have been one of the last survivors during the Spore Queen’s attack on the theater. Unfortunately, he ultimately did not escape…
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42378447/9d4405b03a868a3f4dc6852dca7191410c0a9176.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42378447/90a875d281ac62350b4dedce17e088112a497fa0.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Spodoptera
[*] After Saint Alexus fell under siege by the alien flora, the grand theater was not spared. However, driven by their survival instincts, humans briefly overcame their fear and continued to flee. A few staff members, pushed by the monsters, found themselves moving closer to the center stage. After hiding in the storage room for half an hour, they heard the voice of the missing Ginny over the radio. This strong blonde girl, infected but still fighting, had locked the door from the outside with her last ounce of strength, buying her companions a slim chance of survival.  

The remaining members finally located a ventilation duct and crawled up to the center stage, unaware that this was the source of the disaster. They witnessed a massive and vibrant mutated plant emerging from the underground. The vines swiped across the area, sweeping most of the survivors into the depths. With nowhere to hide, in the final moments, Rosie saw the fully mutated Ginny. The once-envied blonde hair had turned into a grotesque color, falling in clumps as Ginny moved. In her panic, Rosie accidentally activated the radio left behind by a teammate, and Ginny's pre-transformation recording played repeatedly: “I... I will... lock the door from the outside... you all... run!”  

But Rosie decided not to run. She walked toward Ginny, embracing her tightly before Ginny's claws could tear into her throat. Then, a vine snatched both of them into the underground. Time lost its meaning as Rosie felt an overwhelming bloodlust driving her to attack the woman ensnared by the vines. She caught a glimpse of Ginny on the other side. Perhaps that was Ginny, but now, both had transformed into monstrous forms...
[/list]

  ● At the start of the level, 5 spider drones will be created, each with different collection times. Once the time is reached, players can interact with the drones to gain abilities;  
  ● Each interaction with a spider drone grants players the following abilities in order:  
       ◆ Unlimited Firepower: Reduces all skill cooldowns and energy consumption by 75%  
       ◆ Bullet Ricochet: Bullets will bounce to up to 5 nearby targets after hitting an enemy, dealing 50% damage  
       ◆ Battle Hardened: For each enemy unit killed, increases the player’s max health and base attack power  
       ◆ Memory Fusion: The attributes and set effects of two core memory samples will activate simultaneously  
       ◆ Choose one from the following engravings:  
       ◆ Body Ascension: Significantly increases physical skills, attacks trigger double damage, grants 100% elemental boost and 40% movement speed; 【Rare Engraving】only one can be equipped at a time  
       ◆ Battlefield Medic: Shooting teammates restores health for both, with excess healing converted into a shield up to 100% of health max; grants a 1% final damage bonus for every shield point; 【Rare Engraving】only one can be equipped at a time  
       ◆ Heavy Warrior: Replaces main and secondary weapons with a 【Gatling gun】, increases max health by 500%, and automatically regenerates health after 5 seconds without taking damage; 【Rare Engraving】only one can be equipped at a time  
  ● Completing each level grants a limited-time commander character, which can stack in duration. The limited-time commander character will become inactive after the version update on December 19, 2024.

[b]=  New gameplay: the Ultimate Race =[/b]
   ● In response to the increasingly severe global situation, major organizations have united to host a series of elite selection competitions, with the Qiu Loong Camp's events organized by the Star Sea Cooperation. Thanks to the technology sharing from the Zero Realm Forces, the Qiu Loong Camp map is a special area generated using real projection technology. In this area, warriors will undergo the following segments of competition:  
         ◆ Rapid Climbing Stage: Warriors must jump to the highest point as quickly as possible, testing their mastery of jumping abilities;  
         ◆ Precision Marksmanship Stage: Warriors need to use their Qiu Loong flintlock to hit target dragon orbs, competing on speed and accuracy of shooting;  
         ◆ Maze Solving Stage: Warriors must quickly gather all the words from the poem and deliver them to the central area, testing their target recognition skills;  
         ◆ Raft Racing Stage: Warriors must use floating bamboo rafts to quickly reach the opposite shore, presenting a dual challenge of jumping and distance control;  
         ◆ Final Sprint Stage: Warriors must utilize the lightness ability granted by the environment to accurately step on lily pads at varying distances to reach the finish line. At this stage, vision, control, and timing will evolve into extraordinary agility, helping warriors claim the crown and stand atop the Qiu Loong...

[h3][b]Dear Players,[/b][/h3]

Our maintenance is now complete. After the maintenance is complete, each player will receive 1000 Gold and 1000 Stardust Crystals(please claim within 7 days from receiving the mail). We apologize for any inconvenience caused by the update delay!

[h1]SEASON UPDATES[/h1]

[h3]= New PVP Season Now Live =[/h3]

Season 8 Begins After July 3 Maintenance
[list]
[*] During the S8 season, players who reach Gold rank in the Rank and complete 5 matches will unlock the SG550 Rapid Vanguard. Reach Black Gold rank and complete 5 matches to unlock the UMP45 Rapid Vanguard and the Lunar Year Medal III.
[*] During the S8 season, players who reach Gold rank in the Battle Royale and complete 3 matches will unlock the Jetpack - Racing King. Reach Black Gold rank and complete 3 matches to unlock the Off-road vehicle - Extreme Rally.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42378447/2adcd92c7affd2eccf140880227a6cdeecc56614.png[/img]
Prepare for intense battles and strive to unlock these exclusive rewards in the new PVP season!

[h3]= S8 Season Supply Kit =[/h3]

Season Supply Exclusive Weapons (Available from July 3 to August 28)
[list]
[*] New Legendary Weapon: AUG Swift Nova
[/list]Season Supply Exclusive Skins (Available from July 3 to August 28)
[list]
[*] Honey Trap - Twilight Phantom
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42378447/8c14ea9fa32a3bb194c8f0a84d9f75d82d424e93.png[/img]
Gear up and dominate the battlefield with the new exclusive weapon and skin available in the S8 Season Supply Pack!

[h1]INFESTATION [/h1]

[h2]Mainline Update[/h2]

[h3]= Battle of Spore Queen Chapter 1 =[/h3]

After resolving the crisis brought by Heath Bana, the Fringe Squad begins to retreat from the besieged city with the support of aerial forces. However, their evacuation is thwarted when their support helicopter is attacked and crashes. Chloe discovers that communication with headquarters has been cut off. Acting quickly, the commander decides to take refuge in a nearby building, establishing a temporary command center to provide emergency care to the wounded and scout the surrounding area.

In the chaos of the previous battle, the rescue team had to abandon their supplies, so the squad, led by Chloe, must head to a medical center to find medicine. During the ensuing battles, the squad discovers the source of the signal jamming and realizes that the attacking monsters seem to be strategically controlled by someone behind the scenes...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42378447/127f8072a00dcec94877516f257fe9b504553f03.png[/img]
Prepare yourself for intense firefights, strategic maneuvers, and uncovering the mystery behind the enemy's tactics in this thrilling new chapter!

[h2]New Monsters[/h2]

[h3]= Vine Bone Wyvern = [/h3]

A mysterious giant ancient creature's skeleton (possibly from the Era of the King Insects or later) has been transformed into a monster by the Spore Queen's manipulated vines. This creature is primarily controlled by the alien vines. Initially, it is controlled by Hannah, but after being defeated, the vines retract, and Hannah's daughter Mia is taken away.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42378447/c4416e5ec0af20c819553b666ea01854657bc1e4.png[/img]
[h3]= Floating Spores =[/h3]

After receiving intelligence about the DPC Squad's battles in the dungeon, the Spore Queen adapted and produced new remote combat units from its modified gestation sacs. These units are specifically designed to counter enemies like the DPC Squad that rely on long-range firepower. Upon their first appearance, Chloe named these peculiar-looking creatures "Floating Spores."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42378447/e1bc4941737cc4af2af0768e0dc0519753c28429.png[/img]
[h3]= Parasite Infants =[/h3]

One of the explorers sent by Amos to the underground to collect stardust, the sole returning explorer, carries parasitic spores on his body. He was quickly transformed by the parasites. If we exclude the mysteriously disappeared individuals, he is recorded as the first human to be parasitized.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42378447/2bbcb11a5c8229a61931ca2e0650df58f7600b2f.png[/img]
[h3]= Withered Archer =[/h3]

An elite monster created by the Spore Queen through a second gestation process based on the Phantom Butterfly Witch. These creatures can execute precise long-range attacks against the DPC Squad. Due to their gaunt appearance, the commander has named them "Withered Archer."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42378447/f3719c717e691bda3ebb91453c7803c318014378.png[/img]
[h3]= Shadow Reaper =[/h3]

After capturing the Claw Reaper in the dungeon, the Spore Queen enhanced its abilities and produced an elite monster capable of teleportation attacks. Upon detection by Chloe, it was named "Shadow Reaper."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42378447/930843cf5f863a4ece3c240bb5524f0886e090c9.png[/img]
[h3]= Withered Queen =[/h3]

The Spore Queen was dissatisfied with the performance of the Phantom Witch on the battlefield. She consumed the remaining Witches and, using the combat data from the DPC Squad, gestated a more terrifying monarch of the Phantom Witches. Upon first sight, Chloe named this creature the "Phantom Butterfly Witch." During subsequent battles, its ability to command and control other monsters on the battlefield proved it worthy of its regal title.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42378447/c5ebe792bee0de122d9d70c24c632715eda2d319.png[/img]
[h2]SEASON UPDATES[/h2]

[h3]= Turing Support Phase 5 =[/h3]

In the Turing Support, basic support allows players to freely obtain the limited-time core XM8 Singularity Dart. As players unlock more levels in Turing Support, players are able to earn Singularity Dart Chargers. Collecting 10 Singularity Dart Chargers will upgrade the limited-time core XM8 Singularity Dart to a permanent core.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42378447/c1d4e26670d1067277aae1aabd277915bd723ad6.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Players can spend 1360 Tokens to purchase the Advanced Support Pack, which unlocks advanced support rewards, including the Epic Charm: Flower of Mutation, the Core Light Illusion XM8 Singularity  Dart Violet Extreme, and a large amount of Reconstruction Substrates and Stardust Crystals.
[*] Players can spend 2560 Tokens to purchase the Advanced Pack, which unlocks the advanced support and immediately grants an additional 20 support levels, along with extra Reconstruction Substrates, Stardust Crystals, and cultivation materials as rewards.
[/list]
[h3]= Starfall Expedition Season Update =[/h3]

notes.title: Battle Teams 2 Worldwide Release
notes.notes:
[h3]Battle Teams 2 to Be Released Worldwide This February[/h3]

The large-scale online tactical shooting game Battle Teams 2, inheriting a decade of classic IP, is set to [b]debut globally on the Steam platform in February 2024[/b]. An immersive shooting battlefield, multiple game modes from BR to TDM, and innovative games like Big Head Mode and Infection, along with a deep weapon modification system... and more!

The game features a PVE mode with various enemy types and an exploratory open-world map for free adventures. Unique weapon skills and tactical cooperation add excitement to clearing enemies, bidding farewell to mindless monster grinding.

Carrying a unique Asian aesthetic style, the game unfolds a grand narrative, forging an epic and magnificent worldview. With the launch of major updates, each bringing new events, the main storyline unfolds with suspense and excitement!

[b]The exact date of the global release will be communicated with our players soon.[/b]

Join our official Discord now: https://discord.gg/k8tFYBfkJ3

[b]Battle Teams 2 Team[/b]
